title: enrichVolcano
text: package ships one example study: fgsea results four contrasts across five gene-set collections, matching limma differential-abundance table. collections MSigDB Hallmark, KEGG MEDICUS, Reactome GO:BP msigdbr 26.1.0, GO Consortium’s generic GO slim (release 2026-07-26). as_enrichment() recognised fgsea output columns split table contrast column. DA table needs one contrast padj column:  Arc fill NES arc height −log⁡10-\log_{10}(padj). -regulated terms sit upper half, -regulated ones lower. Ticks run arc leading-edge proteins volcano. ring takes twelve significant terms (padj < 0.05), either direction. databases limits named collections, Hallmark GO slim; left default, NULL, every collection object competes. term_threshold, n_terms terms change selection .
code: library(enrichVolcano)  fgsea_path <- system.file("extdata", "examples", "yvo_fgsea.csv.gz", package = "enrichVolcano") da_path <- system.file("extdata", "examples", "yvo_da.csv.gz", package = "enrichVolcano")  ex <- as_enrichment(read.csv(fgsea_path)) #> Reading "fgsea" results. ex #> <enrichment> fgsea, score: NES #> 4 contrasts: Aging, Training_Young, Training_Old, and Interaction #> 5570 rows: GO Slim (108), GO:BP (3946), Hallmark (144), KEGG (84), and Reactome #> (1288) #> Dedup: precomputed da <- read.csv(da_path) names(da)[names(da) == "adj.P.Val"] <- "padj" young <- da[da$contrast == "Training_Young", ] volcano_ring(young, ex,   contrast = "Training_Young", databases = c("Hallmark", "GO Slim"),   title = "Training, young" )

title: enrichVolcano
text: Hallmark GO slim make good default pair figures. 50 Hallmark sets summarise one well-defined biological state, GO Consortium’s generic slim keeps small set broad GO terms. built avoid overlapping terms, every arc says something different. Larger collections GO:BP Reactome find specific terms need dedup(). Hallmark comes msigdbr (CRAN). GO slim list GO IDs; mapping genes needs AnnotationDbi org.Hs.eg.db (Bioconductor), counting genes annotated term descendants: slim spans three GO namespaces terms broad (median 570 human genes), fgsea’s maxSize drops ; example data used sets 15 500 genes. Test collection family, padj corrected within , record packageVersion("msigdbr") OBO file’s data-version line methods.
code: h <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") hallmark <- split(h$gene_symbol, h$gs_name)  obo <- readLines("https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/subsets/goslim_generic.obo") slim <- sub("^id: ", "", grep("^id: GO:", obo, value = TRUE)) entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mget(slim, org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.egGO2ALLEGS, ifnotfound = NA) entrez <- Filter(function(ids) !all(is.na(ids)), entrez) go_slim <- lapply(entrez, function(ids) {   unique(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, unique(ids), "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")) })

code: res <- limma::fry(y, index = gene_sets, design = design, contrast = contrast) x <- as_enrichment(list(Aging = res), database = "Hallmark") fry_res <- data.frame(   NGenes = c(200, 150, 180, 160),   Direction = c("Up", "Up", "Down", "Down"),   PValue = c(1e-6, 4e-4, 2e-5, 3e-3),   FDR = c(4e-6, 8e-4, 4e-5, 4e-3),   PValue.Mixed = c(1e-7, 1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-3),   FDR.Mixed = c(4e-7, 2e-4, 2e-5, 1e-3),   row.names = c(     "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION", "HALLMARK_MYOGENESIS",     "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE", "HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS"   ) ) fry_x <- as_enrichment(list(Training_Young = fry_res), database = "Hallmark") #> Reading "fry" results. volcano_ring(young, fry_x, title = "fry")

title: enrichVolcano
text: Related gene sets often reach significance together. GO:BP Reactome, one biological signal can light dozen overlapping terms. dedup() flags one per cluster "redundant", plots hide redundant terms default (collapse = TRUE). row removed p-value changes: multiple-testing correction already covered every term, redundancy display decision. Within contrast database, significant terms walked smallest padj. term redundant gene set similar enough term already kept: similarity = "combined" (default, cutoff 0.375) EnrichmentMap coefficient: mean Jaccard index overlap coefficient. overlap coefficient catches small set nested inside large one, Jaccard alone misses. similarity = "jaccard" (cutoff 0.5) shared genes genes either set. method = "collapse_pathways" different kind rule. calls fgsea::collapsePathways(), asks whether term still enriched genes significant term conditioned . new statistical test, needs ranking contrast tested , works ranked GSEA results, reported analysis. Call set.seed() first; permutes. example object carries flags computed upstream Jaccard rule. as_enrichment() keeps records object precomputed: Hallmark GO slim lose nothing built non-redundant. flags matter draw GO:BP Reactome:
code: gene_sets <- split(msig$gene_symbol, msig$gs_name) x <- dedup(x, gene_sets) x <- dedup(x, gene_sets, similarity = "jaccard") x <- dedup(x, gene_sets, method = "collapse_pathways", stats = list(Aging = ranks)) table(ex@results$dedup_status, ex@results$database, useNA = "ifany") #>             #>             GO Slim GO:BP Hallmark KEGG Reactome #>   kept           34   173       22   20      292 #>   redundant       0    79        0   35      261 #>   <NA>           74  3694      122   29      735 volcano_ring(young, ex, contrast = "Training_Young", databases = "Reactome", title = "Reactome")

title: enrichVolcano
text: nes_scatter() plots every term’s score one contrast score another. answers two kinds question, set comparison. default, comparison = "concordance", asks whether two conditions regulate pathways. Terms shaded top-right bottom-left quadrants move way .  comparison = "reversal" asks whether one condition undoes another. unshaded quadrants hold answer: pathway raised aging lowered training, reverse. reference line becomes y=−xy = -x.  term counts significant contrast padj p_threshold (0.05); colour says whether holds one contrast . Pathways judged false discovery rate alone. Scores combine effect size p, π\pi-value, defined single proteins, gene sets. corner counts headline share use significant terms ; Spearman’s ρ\rho uses every plotted term, 95% interval correlation package installed. color_by shape_by take per-term column, example color_by = "database", databases, collapse label_min_size work ring.
code: nes_scatter(ex, "Training_Young", "Training_Old", databases = c("Hallmark", "GO Slim")) nes_scatter(ex, "Aging", "Training_Old",   comparison = "reversal", databases = c("Hallmark", "GO Slim") )

title: enrichVolcano
text: volcano_ring_theme() holds palette; plot arguments hold layout. arguments reach : magnitude: arc height encodes, "neg_log_padj" "size". arc_height_range: shortest tallest arc. arc_order: order arcs "padj" absolute score within half. x_scale, y_scale: compress volcano points crowd ring. label_mode, label_n, label_genes: proteins get text. show_counts, disc_color: count badges tinted central disc. volcano_ring_grid() draws one ring per contrast collects shared legend; extra arguments pass every ring.
code: volcano_ring(young, ex,   contrast = "Training_Young", databases = c("Hallmark", "GO Slim"),   theme = volcano_ring_theme(palette = "okabe"),   label_mode = "top_per_direction", label_n = 4 ) g <- volcano_ring_grid(da, ex, contrasts = c("Training_Young", "Training_Old"), ncol = 2) g$plot

Raise wide label boxes clipped; lower pack ring tighter. disc_color Optional fill tinted central disc. nes_limits Length-2 numeric NULL; limits arc fill scale. NULL uses c(-3, 3) NES, otherwise spans largest absolute significant score whole object, every contrast shares scale. magnitude arc height encodes: "neg_log_padj" "size". NULL picks "neg_log_padj" NES "size" otherwise, fill height never repeat number fry camera results; without set sizes falls back "neg_log_padj". arc_order Angular order arcs within /half: "padj" (default, lowest FDR first) "nes" (strongest absolute score first). /split always direction. arc_height_range Length-2 numeric c(min, max) shortest tallest arc; widen exaggerate magnitude encoding. show_counts Draw /significant-point count badges. point_size, point_alpha Volcano point size (default 1.1) opacity. label_size Pathway-label text size. label_gap Radial gap arc's outer top label (default 0.6). Anchoring per-arc keeps every leader line short length regardless arc height; label box grows outward point never overlaps arc. Widen lengthen leaders. count_size Text size /count badges (default 2.4). count_x_mult, count_y_mult Badge position fraction volcano radius (default 0.7). axis_size Text size //log2 FC/-log10 p axis annotations (default 2.2). label_mode, label_n, label_rank_by, label_genes Volcano point labels. theme Output volcano_ring_theme().
